They should cover the…. Only part of this sub-goal is done. Tests now cover the screen fade-out followed by the scene start, and the cleanup when the scene shuts down. Nothing handles or tests an empty or unknown scene name, so a bad scene change request is not rejected.

assessment.requirements: Delivered: tests on the real scene code show a fade-out before the scene starts, and the listener is removed on shutdown. Not delivered: ignoring an empty or unknown scene name. The scene code has no check for it, and no test covers it. The Verify report says 3 tests passed for this, but I found none in the test files.
assessment.business: Players get a smooth fade between scenes. A bad scene change request, such as an empty name from a content error, could still break the transition, and that is not caught.
assessment.technical: The transition listener and its cleanup are sound and tested against the real scene code. The start call passes the scene name straight through with no validation. An empty or unregistered name will make Phaser start a missing scene or throw an error. The Verify claim for this case is not backed by any test I could find.

remaining_gaps: Technical: In the real scene code, make the scene-change handler return early, with no fade-out and no scene start, when the scene id is empty, whitespace, or not a registered scene key.

Technical: Add unit tests on the real scene code, with Phaser and the stores mocked, that emit the scene-change event with an empty id, a whitespace id, and an unregistered id. Assert that the camera does not fade out and the scene does not start.
